# RPIR architecture decision records

## Purpose and consumers

Use this resource-backed capability to identify architectural choices upfront in Research and reconcile every architectural choice, including planning discoveries, against inspected ADR coverage by Plan. Proportionality governs detail, not coverage: small, reversible projects and spikes are not exemptions. It supports Research, Plan, Implement, and Review; it is not a fifth RPIR phase, an ADR requirement for every coding choice, a phase-wide invocation gate, or an authority grant.

Component topology (for example separate web/API components), technology/toolchain baselines (such as frontend technology or Aspire), public contracts (such as numeric semantics), and security/data boundaries are architectural commitments. Dependency or test-framework changes are context-sensitive: assess whether they change platform, integration, compatibility or operational commitments rather than classifying by package name alone. Naming, helper extraction and architecture-preserving local repairs are routine coding choices that Implement may make without ADR reference. Resolve material classification ambiguity with the engineer using evidence and the shared question-resolution method; do not silently exempt a disputed choice.

## Inputs and outputs

- **Inputs:** relevant Research evidence and citations, attributed engineer statements, alternatives and their reasoning, consequential unknowns, verified consumer conventions/governance, and—downstream—the inspected Plan-bound ADR identity/version and conditions.
- **Outputs:** a compact Research handover identifying architectural choices and gaps; complete choice-to-ADR reconciliation in Plan, with associated Proposed drafts only when authorized; and truthful downstream consistency findings. The Plan remains the sole delivery hierarchy and authority for delivery scope and acceptance.

Use the [Research input coverage map](references/research-input-coverage.md) proportionately and the [ADR template](templates/adr.md) for necessary authorized drafts. Reuse existing answers and citations; do not restart the Research interview or require all map fields for every decision.

Use the [shared reader-facing rule](../rpir-lifecycle-core/SKILL.md#reader-facing-outputs) for lifecycle reports: link inspected ADR rationale/alternatives instead of copying them, while keeping exact path/section/substantive version/state, actual agreement/conditions, affected work and each record's invocation/recording result visible. ADRs themselves remain standalone and understandable without local lifecycle records; do not replace their context, realistic alternatives, reasoning or conditions with links alone. Missing/unreadable sources need an explicit affected-effect gap and resolution route, not a claimed inspection or phase-wide stop.

## Complete coverage and reuse

For each architectural choice, preserve its identifiable subject, drivers/rationale, realistic alternatives and option-specific reasoning, actual selection or explicit pending state, conditions and affected work. Research identifies likely affected work; Plan maps it to its existing Work Item IDs. Plan binds coverage to each inspected ADR's actual path/ID, identifiable section, substantive version or snapshot, decision state, actual agreement evidence and conditions. A valid binding for one choice does not cover omitted choices.

Inspect existing ADRs for substantive applicability before reusing them; appropriate verified coverage needs no duplicate ADR. Group related choices only where shared context, rationale and governance make this meaningful, while keeping each choice's alternatives, selection/pending state, reasoning, conditions and affected Work Items individually identifiable. A vague umbrella record is not coverage. Independently changing status, authority or supersession favours separate records. Do not add a competing delivery register.

Unknown destinations, unavailable records, pending choices/agreement or unmet decision-critical conditions remain visible gaps with dependent effects and an evidence/engineer-resolution route. They are not invented coverage or Accepted state. Constrain dependent effects, not phase invocation or independent safe work; do not invent governance prerequisites.

## Phase operation

1. **Research:** Explicitly identify architectural choices after the existing discovery/acknowledgment or explicit-deferral rules permit investigation. Reuse evidence, cite its existing location, identify existing ADR candidates and actual engineer selections separately from recommendations, and hand over consequential gaps/routes. The [Research method](../rpir-codebase-research/SKILL.md) requires a supported viable mechanism and decision-critical feasibility for a technically sufficient conclusion; an essential gap is unfinished Research whether architectural or not. Research never authors a standalone ADR or the formal delivery hierarchy.
2. **Plan:** Reconcile all Research choices and choices discovered during planning to complete inspected ADR coverage as above; if none are architectural, give an evidence-supported routine-only disposition. Check the conclusion's freshness/applicability and convert the supported mechanism into delivery under the [planning method](../rpir-architecture-planning/SKILL.md). An inherited essential gap or feasibility reopened by genuinely new requirements/evidence needs an affected-gap explanation and recommended scoped engineer-directed Research continuation or supplementation when evidence is needed, not hidden essential research in delivery tasks. Keep truthful drafts, independent planning and manual invocation, without automatic restart or retroactive blame. The RPIR Plan coordinator may create or revise only a Proposed ADR directly associated with its active planning objective, alongside the working Plan and before the Implement transition, under the safeguards below. Required coverage does not grant authorship or guess a destination. Keep one authoritative Plan hierarchy. Separate Plan/ADR saves require separate inspection and readback; report partial persistence honestly.
3. **Implement:** Inspect exact Plan-bound ADR identity/version/state/conditions. An eligible deliberate Implement request, including manual Implement/remediation Skill invocation under already-effective policy, signs off only complete exact Proposed snapshots visibly listed in the Plan handoff, without duplicate routine approval. The [core exact-record effect](../rpir-lifecycle-core/SKILL.md#prospective-exact-adr-sign-off-recording-effect) owns separate coordinator-only Accepted/date/agreement recording, unchanged preimage/authority/permission/conflict checks, non-overwriting save and complete per-record readback. On correction/resume verify unchanged already-recorded Accepted postimages, original exact Plan bindings and original agreement/recording evidence; do not require Proposed state, re-sign or rewrite metadata. Fresh still-Proposed targets use fresh-agreement guards. Changed/superseded decisions, uncertain agreement or unverifiable recording constrain only dependent effects, preserving independent work/successes; do not float to a newer/unlisted decision. Edits and prior invocation are not retroactive/self-activating, and no worker/Runner/Review/helper ADR authority is granted. For an absent or invalid essential mechanism use the [implementation method](../rpir-safe-implementation/SKILL.md) to seek engineer/Plan resolution and scoped Research where evidence is needed; ordinary diagnosis/recheck remain available.
4. **Review:** Independently compare implementation and evidence with the Plan-bound architectural choice and assess whether governance claims are supported. A clean delivery Review is not architectural or enterprise approval.

## Consumer convention resolution

The Plan coordinator first inspects for an established consumer ADR convention and applicable existing coverage. Reuse an unambiguous verified convention without needless confirmation or duplicate ADRs. If no convention is evidenced, ask the engineer to select or qualify one concrete proposed new convention before applying it; do not merely record "resolve later" or assign ADR preparation to Implement.

Present one explained choice under the shared question contract. Recommend a literal contained destination grounded in the verified consumer root, a concrete naming scheme (for example the next unused `NNN-subject.md`), the shipped self-contained ADR template, and a proposed status vocabulary with its agreement rules (for example Proposed/Accepted/Rejected/Superseded). Identify retention, renderer or governance gaps when consequential. These are proposals, not existing consumer rules or a Toolkit-wide default; never assume `docs/adr/` or any example bundle applies. Offer meaningful alternatives and a final free-text/unknown/other route, then wait for the actual selection. Preserve an engineer-selected alternative and qualifications rather than substituting the recommendation.

Only after actual selection, the RPIR Plan coordinator may prepare associated Proposed ADRs within its existing exception. Separately guard each selected missing directory and each ADR file for identity, containment, absence/collision and effective permission, then inspect the created result and save/read back each file. Bind every choice to exact path/ID, section, substantive version, state, actual agreement/conditions and affected Work Items; keep one delivery hierarchy and preserve accepted history. Selection is not directory capability or permission: an absent selected directory remains unavailable for ADR persistence until its supported operation and authority are established. Plan may use RPIR Script Runner for a selected missing ADR directory under the bounded setup contract; do not hide that essential mechanism or its guards in Implement.

A missing, denied or unavailable directory operation holds only dependent directory/ADR writes. Report the actual limitation and next evidence/engineer route while independent planning continues; do not claim a creation or save that was not observed. Plan may use RPIR Script Runner for a selected missing ADR directory under the bounded setup contract, only after separately checking literal identity, containment, absence/collision and permission, and must inspect the result before the next effect. No coordinator-shell, implicit-parent file-save or alternate-destination workaround is authorized, and a real denial must not be bypassed.

## Authority and effect safeguards

The RPIR Plan coordinator's narrowly defined exception is owned by repository policy and the RPIR Plan coordinator, not by this Skill. It permits only the associated Proposed ADR draft and its guarded revision during active planning. It does not authorize code/configuration edits, unrelated documents or ADRs, register edits, reciprocal metadata changes, accepted/superseded history rewrites, commits, distribution, publication, or a new agent/prompt/tool route. Research, Implement, Review, analysts, workers, and RPIR Script Runner gain no ADR authorship authority from this resource. The core separately defines a prospective Implement-coordinator-only sign-off metadata effect; it is not ADR authorship and is unavailable unless that policy is already effective before the qualifying invocation.

Use evidenced consumer naming, location, retention, required template, renderer, and governance conventions. Do not select a guessed fallback destination or invent approval, standards, owners, participants, dates, or agreement. A necessary directory may be created only at an explicitly engineer-selected, verified contained destination. Do not recursively create unselected ancestors; each missing directory needs its own explicit selection and separate identity, containment, absence/collision, and permission checks. Check each ADR file effect separately for identity, containment, absence/collision, effective permission, saved result, and readback. Never overwrite or silently relocate on collision; reconcile concurrency and disclose a failed or partial save. Preserve accepted and superseded substantive history. A Proposed/Accepted/Rejected/Superseded vocabulary is only a candidate unless consumer conventions establish it; decision status is not delivery progress or approval by phase invocation.

For fresh agreement, unconditional Accepted requires actual applicable decision authority and agreement evidence, with all applicable required decision approvals and decision-critical conditions satisfied. Otherwise retain Proposed or an explicitly qualified/pending state according to evidenced consumer conventions. Verification of an unchanged already-recorded Accepted decision on resume is not fresh agreement or permission to rewrite its state. Actual agreement and its conditions remain distinct from delivery approval and acceptance.

See the [lifecycle core](../rpir-lifecycle-core/SKILL.md) and phase-owned instructions for canonical intake, authority, permissions, and manual transitions. This Skill grants no tools, permissions, approval, lifecycle authority, or runtime guarantee.
